items.title: A Fresh Look
items.description: Settings, onboarding, and empty screens share a calmer, more expressive design.

items.title: Your Own Task Markers
items.description: Choose the text or emoji for dates, priority, and recurrence, still compatible with Obsidian Tasks.

items.title: Widgets Your Way
items.description: Pick the list each widget shows, hide completed tasks, and see changes right away.

items.title: Polish & Fixes
items.description: Back gestures slide naturally, and a rare freeze from the floating button is fixed.

items.title: Safer Note Links
items.description: Notes opened from other apps or widgets are now validated before they are read.
